api.rateLimited: Too many requests — please slow down

auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again later.

blackboard.pullRequired: Go to the newest entry first, then try again.
blackboard.noData: Nothing to upload. Write something first.

walkieTypie.noLocalData: No messages yet. Start typing to create one.

broadcast.notOwner: Only the owner can do this.

system.loginRequired: Please log in for this action.
system.storageFull: Storage full. Changes may not be saved.

hints.push: Go forward to newer entries. If you're already at the newest, a blank page appears — just start typing to create a new entry.
hints.pull: Go back to view older entries in this topic. Your current text is saved automatically before switching.
hints.commit: Upload all entries of this topic to the cloud. Everything is sent at once. If another device uploaded first, the latest upload wins.
hints.checkout: Download the selected topic from the cloud to your device.
hints.switch: Switch to the selected topic on your device.
hints.fork: Create an independent copy of this entire topic. The copy and the original won't affect each other afterward.
hints.dropClean: Erase all entries in this topic but keep the topic itself for future use. One blank placeholder will remain.
hints.dropDrop: Remove the cloud copy of this topic. Your local entries on this device stay untouched.
hints.dropDelete: Permanently delete this empty topic from your device. This cannot be undone.

wt.theyPush: View newer entries on your partner's board.
wt.theyPull: View older entries on your partner's board.
wt.wePush: View newer entries on your shared board.
wt.wePull: View older entries on your shared board.
wt.add: Connect with someone by entering their user ID.
wt.cut: Remove the connection with your selected partner.

bc.pin: Save this channel to your favourites for easy access.
bc.cast: Send your text as a new message to the channel.
bc.create: Create a new public channel anyone can join.
bc.delete: Delete a channel you created. This cannot be undone.

mods.refresh: Check if all MOD servers are still connected.

config.maxSlot: How many entries to keep per topic. Oldest entries are removed when full.
config.autoCleanBlanks: Automatically delete blank entries when you move to another entry.
config.updateTimestamp: When you edit an old entry, move it to the top so it appears as the newest.
config.autoSync: Keep your entries in sync across devices automatically. You need to be logged in.
config.loopList: When you scroll past the end of a list, jump back to the beginning.
config.boardSwap: Show your partner's messages at the top by default.
config.screensaverTimeout: How long to wait before the screensaver appears.
config.crtBlendMode: Make the screen lines less harsh by blending them more softly.

llm.button: Use AI to process the text on your screen.
llm.provider: Where the AI runs: in your browser, on a local server, or in the cloud.
llm.clientModel: The AI model that runs directly in your browser. Bigger models are smarter but slower.
llm.apiProvider: Which cloud AI service to connect to.
llm.apiModel: The specific AI model to use from your cloud provider.
llm.apiKey: Your secret key for the cloud AI. It stays on your device only.
llm.temperature: How creative the AI should be. Low = precise, High = creative.

llmBb.button: Analyze your log entries with AI.
llmBb.target: What to analyze: entries from this topic, or all topics combined.

llmBc.target: What to analyze: the current message, or all messages in the channel.

translate.button: Translate the text on your screen to another language.

stt.button: Use your microphone to type by speaking.

markdownPreview.button: See a formatted preview of your text (headings, bold, lists, etc.).

aa.matrixRain: Animated falling characters on the idle screen, inspired by The Matrix.
aa.perlinBg: A gentle animated texture behind your content, like shifting clouds.
aa.mouseLight: A soft glow that follows your cursor around the screen.
aa.toastAnim: Add a spinning animation to loading messages.

mods.configDefault: Select an extension from the list.
mods.catalogPreview: Add this extension to start configuring.
mods.validationFailed: Extension '{id}' failed to load — check console
mods.loadFailed: Extension failed to load — check console
